stem.text: An autocatalytic reaction is a reaction in which one of the products catalyses the reaction.
Which curve would be obtained if the rate of an autocatalytic reaction is plotted against time?

A.alt: Rate against time: rate rises steeply from zero, then levels off at a constant plateau

B.alt: Rate against time: rate starts at zero, rises slowly then steeply in an S-shape, then levels off

C.alt: Rate against time: rate rises from zero to a maximum, then falls

D.alt: Rate against time: rate starts at a maximum and falls steadily
